traits.name: Sun-Blessed
traits.flavor: Dawn finds them first, and lingers.
traits.crunch: Holy +20%; Sagacity growth +10%; Blind resist +25%; recruits favor fair hair and gold eyes.

traits.name: Favors the Night
traits.flavor: They were never afraid of the dark. The dark is afraid of them.
traits.crunch: Dark +15%; Evasion +5%; Guile growth +10%; night-tagged events offer an extra option.

traits.name: Students of the Arcane
traits.flavor: Every child learns the words before they learn to walk.
traits.crunch: Acuity growth +15%; max MP +10%; Magus, Conjurer, Abjurer Job XP +15%.

traits.name: Iron Discipline
traits.flavor: Ranks hold. Ranks always hold.
traits.crunch: Resilience growth +10%; Wait/Defend costs 50 CT instead of 60.

traits.name: Martial Lineage
traits.flavor: Every portrait in the hall holds a blade.
traits.crunch: Might growth +10%; Arms Durability +15%; Soldier, Knight, Ravager, Sword Saint Job XP +15%.

traits.name: Old Blood of Kings
traits.flavor: Their claim is older than the throne.
traits.crunch: Recruit pool +1; Charm resist +25%; Lineage score +10%.

traits.name: Forge-Born
traits.flavor: Soot in the cradle, sparks at the wedding.
traits.crunch: Fire +15%; crafting costs −15%; Might growth +5%.

traits.name: Silver Tongues
traits.flavor: They never lie. They never need to.
traits.crunch: Intrigue score +10%; your Crisis pledges can never be leaked; persuasion-tagged events resolve in your favor more often.

traits.name: Salt in the Veins
traits.flavor: Born on decks, buried at sea.
traits.crunch: Water +20%; Legs Durability +10%; sea and drowning events offer an extra option.

traits.name: Hunters of the Deep Wood
traits.flavor: They hear the forest breathe.
traits.crunch: Wind +15%; bow and thrown weapon accuracy +10%; Legs Durability +10%.

traits.name: Faithful of the Pale Saint
traits.flavor: Their prayers are answered. Not always kindly.
traits.crunch: Sanity +20%; mental ailment resist +15%; Soothsayer Job XP +15%.

traits.name: Long-Lived
traits.flavor: Grandmother fought in the war before the last war.
traits.crunch: Mentors teach 50% faster; injuries heal 1 Year sooner; Retired Scions keep their passives.

traits.name: Many-Branched Tree
traits.flavor: There is always another cousin.
traits.crunch: +1 recruit arrival every other Year; recruit growths −5%.

traits.name: Lucky Star
traits.flavor: Fortune has a favorite, and it's them.
traits.crunch: Tarot drawn twice, keep the better; crit chance +3%; Gambler Job XP +20%.

traits.name: Deep Coffers
traits.flavor: Old mines, older debts owed to them.
traits.crunch: Income +20%; Earth +15%.

traits.name: Fleet of Foot
traits.flavor: Couriers, outriders, thieves.
traits.crunch: 30% of recruits roll the innate trait Fleet (+1 Speed); move CT cost −10.

traits.name: Unbroken
traits.flavor: Whatever happens, they get back up.
traits.crunch: Injury table rolls +1 step on all locations.

traits.name: Beastmasters
traits.flavor: The kennels are larger than the house.
traits.crunch: Conjurer summons +15% HP; beast-tagged events offer an extra option; Alterer beast forms last 20% longer.

traits.name: Patrons of the Guilds
traits.flavor: Every craftsman owes them a favor.
traits.crunch: Shop prices −10%; shop unlocks one tier earlier for this House.

traits.name: Grim Physicians
traits.flavor: They have opened more bodies than any graveyard.
traits.crunch: Healing received +10%; Body Durability +10%; Infirmary upkeep −50%.

traits.name: Fond of Wine
traits.flavor: A glass for courage, a bottle for grief.
traits.crunch: Poison resist +25%; Sanity recovers +1 step per Year in town.

traits.name: Keen-Eyed
traits.flavor: Nothing escapes their notice.
traits.crunch: Accuracy +3%.

traits.name: Stout
traits.flavor: Built like the walls of their keep.
traits.crunch: Body Durability +10%.

traits.name: Hardy Stock
traits.flavor: Plain food, hard winters, long lives.
traits.crunch: Max HP +5%.

traits.name: Light Sleepers
traits.flavor: One eye open, always.
traits.crunch: Sleep resist +30%; ambush events: your Scions act first.

traits.name: Scholarly
traits.flavor: The library has more doors than the house.
traits.crunch: Insight buildings cost −20%.

traits.name: Pious
traits.flavor: They pray before every meal and every killing.
traits.crunch: Holy +10%; Sanity +5%.

traits.name: Thrifty
traits.flavor: Waste is a sin, and so is generosity.
traits.crunch: Upkeep −10%.

traits.name: Herbalists
traits.flavor: Every garden bed is medicinal. Mostly.
traits.crunch: Consumable healing +20%.

traits.name: Duelists
traits.flavor: First blood settles most arguments.
traits.crunch: Counter chance +5% with a one-handed weapon.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.flavor: They have eaten worse.
traits.crunch: Food and feast events never poison them; Poison resist +10%.

traits.name: Cold-Blooded
traits.flavor: Calm when the roof is on fire.
traits.crunch: Stun and Fear resist +15%.

traits.name: Night-Eyed
traits.flavor: They see by starlight.
traits.crunch: Blind resist +30%; no accuracy penalty in darkness.

traits.name: Steady Hands
traits.flavor: Patient as a surgeon.
traits.crunch: Crit +3% with knives and ranged weapons.

traits.name: Beloved of the Common Folk
traits.flavor: The people would bleed for them.
traits.crunch: Crisis hidden swing shifts +5% in your favor when you pledge fully.

traits.name: Well-Traveled
traits.flavor: They have seen stranger things than this.
traits.crunch: Once per expedition, reveal one hidden event outcome.

traits.name: Musical
traits.flavor: Every Scion can carry a tune.
traits.crunch: Minstrel Job XP +20%; Deaf resist +25%.

traits.name: Tinkerers' Blood
traits.flavor: They take apart clocks for fun.
traits.crunch: Tinkerers start battles with +1 Component.

traits.name: Dicers
traits.flavor: They bet on everything, including you.
traits.crunch: Gambler dice: one reroll per battle.

traits.name: Horse-Lords
traits.flavor: They ride before they walk.
traits.crunch: Travel and pursuit events offer an extra option; escape checks +20%.

traits.name: Grave-Keepers
traits.flavor: They know every name in the cemetery.
traits.crunch: Death-tagged events offer an extra option; Sanity loss from corpses −50%.

traits.name: Ink and Seal
traits.flavor: Every bargain is written down.
traits.crunch: Your deals are always public and count double for Renown; your Wards' Loyalty swings are halved.

traits.name: Hound-Loyal
traits.flavor: Their servants would die for them, and have.
traits.crunch: Wards placed with you are 20% less likely to leak intel.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.flavor: They have never fallen. Not once.
traits.crunch: Knockdown and Slow resist +25%.

traits.name: Cursed Line
traits.flavor: Something was promised, long ago.
traits.crunch: Each Year, 20% chance a random Scion gains a Curse trait.

traits.name: Brittle Bones
traits.flavor: They break like dry kindling.
traits.crunch: Arms and Legs Durability −20%; injury rolls on those locations −1 step.

traits.name: Haunted Halls
traits.flavor: The house is never empty.
traits.crunch: Sanity −15%; extra haunting House events.

traits.name: Poor Lands
traits.flavor: Thin soil, thinner harvests.
traits.crunch: Income −20%.

traits.name: Sickly
traits.flavor: Coughs that never quite go away.
traits.crunch: Poison and Disease resist −30%; max HP −5%.

traits.name: Craven Legacy
traits.flavor: Their grandfather ran. Everyone remembers.
traits.crunch: Fear resist −30%; Valor score −10%.

traits.name: Debt-Ridden
traits.flavor: The creditors followed them through the rift.
traits.crunch: Start with a debt; interest each Year until repaid; default costs a building.

traits.name: Bad Blood
traits.flavor: No one trusts them, and they know it.
traits.crunch: Recruit pool −1; Wards you give arrive Distrustful.

traits.name: Hot-Blooded
traits.flavor: Every insult is answered in blood.
traits.crunch: Berserk and Confuse resist −30%; some events force the bold option.

traits.name: Elemental Bane
traits.flavor: One element hates them.
traits.crunch: Pick an element: −50% to it (stacks with affinity).

traits.name: Hubris
traits.flavor: They were born to lead. They insist on it.
traits.crunch: When your Scion is Expedition Leader, negative leader-targeted outcomes are worse.

traits.name: Feud
traits.flavor: A rival family followed them into the dark.
traits.crunch: Assassination and sabotage House events target you.

traits.name: Barren
traits.flavor: The cradles stay empty.
traits.crunch: Recruit arrivals every other Year only; recruit growths +5%.

traits.name: Faithless
traits.flavor: No god has ever answered them.
traits.crunch: Holy −20%; blessing events offer you fewer options.

traits.name: Hollow Hearts
traits.flavor: They feel little, and show less.
traits.crunch: Sanity +10% but Sanity never recovers in town; only events and buildings restore it.

traits.name: Vain
traits.flavor: Every Scion owns a mirror.
traits.crunch: Disfiguring injuries also cost Sanity.

traits.name: Superstitious
traits.flavor: Salt on the sill, iron over the door.
traits.crunch: Tarot has a 25% chance to be Reversed (inverted effect).

traits.name: Proud
traits.flavor: They do not take charity.
traits.crunch: Accepting a Ward or loan costs Accord.

traits.name: Gluttonous
traits.flavor: The larders are always empty.
traits.crunch: Upkeep +10%.

traits.name: Slow to Wake
traits.flavor: Late to every battle.
traits.crunch: Scions start battles at −20 CT.

traits.name: Squeamish
traits.flavor: They faint at the sight of blood.
traits.crunch: Sanity loss from gore events +50%.

traits.name: Restless
traits.flavor: They hate waiting.
traits.crunch: Recruits idle 2 Years may leave.

traits.name: Insular
traits.flavor: Outsiders are not welcome.
traits.crunch: Mentor loans to or from you cost double.

traits.name: Sun-Shy
traits.flavor: Pale, and pained by daylight.
traits.crunch: Holy −10%; day-tagged events cost a little Sanity.

traits.name: Loud
traits.flavor: You hear them before you see them.
traits.crunch: Stealth and ambush event options are worse.

traits.name: Light-Fingered Servants
traits.flavor: Things go missing.
traits.crunch: Lose a small amount of stores each Year.

traits.name: Heavy-Handed
traits.flavor: They break more than they mend.
traits.crunch: Crafting failure chance +10%.

traits.name: Grudge-Holders
traits.flavor: They never forget.
traits.crunch: Whenever your House loses a vote, your Scions in town lose 5% Sanity that Year.

traits.name: Drunkards
traits.flavor: Fond of wine, and then some.
traits.crunch: Accuracy −10% for the first 200 ticks of each battle; Sanity +5%.

traits.name: Demon-Blooded
traits.flavor: A bargain sealed in the family's blood.
traits.crunch: Dark +30%, Fire +15%; Might and Acuity growth +10%. Holy −40%; holy-faction events turn hostile; possession events can target your Scions.

traits.name: Grave-Touched
traits.flavor: Their dead don't stay buried. Neither, quite, do they.
traits.crunch: Dark +40%; Poison and Death resist +50%. Healing received −25%; no natural HP regeneration on expeditions.

traits.name: Fae-Changeling
traits.flavor: Not every child in the nursery is theirs.
traits.crunch: 50% of recruits roll Fleet; Charm resist +50%; Wind +20%. Cannot wear heavy armor; changeling events may swap a recruit.

traits.name: Wyrm-Blooded
traits.flavor: Scales under the skin.
traits.crunch: Max HP +15%; Fire +25%. Relics can never leave the House (no gifts or trades); Treasury upkeep +10%.

traits.name: Moon-Cursed
traits.flavor: On certain nights, the hounds don't bark at them. They flee.
traits.crunch: Alterer werewolf form for any Scion as an innate ability; Might growth +10%. Full-moon events: chance of uncontrolled frenzy in town.

traits.name: Hollow-Eyed Seers
traits.flavor: They see what's coming. It doesn't help them sleep.
traits.crunch: Once per event, preview one outcome; Acuity growth +15%. Sanity −25%.

traits.name: Sanguine
traits.flavor: They drink to their health. Not wine.
traits.crunch: Melee attacks drain 5% of damage as HP. Holy −40%; daylight events cost HP.

traits.name: Drowned God's Kin
traits.flavor: Promised to the deep before they were born.
traits.crunch: Water +40%; Sanity +10%. Fire −30%; the sea calls: drowning events target you.

traits.name: Nephilim
traits.flavor: Something winged knelt in their family chapel.
traits.crunch: Holy +40%; healing dealt +15%. Dark −40%; refuse surrender and retreat options in events.

traits.name: Hive-Touched
traits.flavor: The house hums at night.
traits.crunch: Poison resist +50%; summons +1 per cast. Sanity −15%; insect-tagged events target you.
